hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress and elevated advisory risk warrant reduced gross exposure and capital preservation. ETH's long signal is weakened by high beta, high volatility, and negative alpha; SOL and LTC are especially weak on composite, institutional, and liquidity measures. XRP is fragile because its positive signal is modest while zero volatility and expected shortfall appear anomalous. BTC remains the most defensible asset but lacks directional confirmation.
